Description: WILL portfolio assistant: Gemini secret, streamed Lambda API and automatic Amplify API rewrite. Creates billable AWS resources; Gemini usage is billed by Google.

Label.default: Required: paste your existing Gemini key
Portfolio connection: defaults match Villiam’s Amplify app

GeminiApiKey.ConstraintDescription: Enter only the API key: letters, numbers, dots, underscores or hyphens, with no spaces or quotes.
GeminiApiKey.Description: Paste your Gemini API key here, without quotes or spaces. Dots in AQ-format keys are accepted. Stored only in Secrets Manager; never placed in the frontend.

AmplifyAppId.Description: Existing Amplify app in the same AWS account and region. This stack adds its assistant rewrite.

FrontendOrigin.Description: Exact HTTPS website origin with no trailing slash or path. For a custom domain, use that domain.

TextModel.Description: Model ID available to your Gemini API key.

Properties.Description: Permanent Gemini key used only by the WILL backend.
WILL streamed chat, WAV speech and constrained Live session tokens.
Adds/removes only this stack’s assistant rewrite, preserving other Amplify rules.

StatusUrl.Description: Open after CREATE_COMPLETE. Must show JSON with provider gemini; this confirms configuration, not a successful paid model call.

BackendStatusUrl.Description: Direct backend status for diagnosing an Amplify proxy problem.

AssistantFunctionName.Description: Lambda function; use its CloudWatch logs for request failures.

GeminiSecretArn.Description: Secret location for future key rotation; this output never includes the key.
